🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: narrow sector breadth (4/11) and mixed risk signals — VXX falling (VXX (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND) while credit metrics show strain in the regime signal (HYG/LQD flagged); overall conflicting inputs justify CAUTION.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear easing but uneven: VXX (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND shows lower realized fear while Stocks vs Bonds rising (SPY/TLT ↑) with SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +8.49%) ABOVE TREND. Credit spreads modestly tighter (Credit Spread Level 1W: -0.45% | 1M: +0.36% → CORRECTION) and semis leadership remains a cyclical reflation driver (SOXX (1W: +11.71% | 1M: +37.42%) ABOVE TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-supportive: Dollar softening UUP proxy (1W: -0.51% | 1M: -0.36%) BELOW TREND while the yield-curve is steepening (Yield Curve 1W: +1.13% | 1M: -0.27% RECOVERY) and TLT (1W: +0.55% | 1M: -0.35%) in RECOVERY — conditions not strongly restrictive.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech-led: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +23.54%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.71% | 1M: +37.42%) are the clear winners while XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -2.84%) and XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -5.15%) lag; Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength vs Value.

5. US vs Global?  
US and select EM strength: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +8.49%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +16.56%) lead, while EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +12.71%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +2.62%) show EM participation; Europe/Japan are mixed with regional ratios in modest recovery.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Present but cooling: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +14.80%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +11.10%) show risk-on flows while the Speculation Index is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.55% | 1M: +5.18%), indicating tentative retail/speculative demand.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial reflation evidence: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +8.69%) and copper/gold ratio ↑ rising support cyclical demand; GLD in RECOVERY (1W: +2.50% | 1M: -0.95%)—gold acting as a hedge amid mixed equity breadth.

8. Energy Trend?  
Weakness continues: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -2.84%) and BNO in CORRECTION (1W: -7.26% | 1M: +9.46%) show oil volatility and short-term pullback; UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.85%) signals soft gas demand.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership is intact with XLK and SOXX both ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Narrow breadth (4/11) and TLT in RECOVERY versus SPY ABOVE TREND constitute a MINOR divergence — monitor for spillover if breadth fails to expand.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to growth/tech ETFs (XLK, QQQ, SOXX) while reducing exposure to lagging defensives and energy (XLU, XLE); monitor credit spreads and breadth for signs the CAUTION regime resolves toward risk-on or risk-off.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Continued semis momentum → SOXX (1W: +11.71% | 1M: +37.42%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy and Utilities pressure → XLE (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND; watch XLU (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -5.15%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper reflation → CPER (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil volatility → BNO (1W: -7.26% | 1M: +9.46%) CORRECTION and natural gas UNG (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (complacency), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF ~3.4 (growth vs value tilt), SPY/TLT ~8.57 (stocks vs bonds risk-on threshold).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, mixed risk signals and narrow leadership keep the regime cautious. XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.43% | 1M: +23.54%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.71% | 1M: +37.42%) showing relative strength. Key risk is narrow breadth and credit/interest-rate divergence — monitor HYG (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.35%) and VXX (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -7.67%) for regime inflection.
